diff --git a/platform/wecom/mention_regression_test.go b/platform/wecom/mention_regression_test.go
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/platform/wecom/mention_regression_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,70 @@
+package wecom
+
+import (
+	"encoding/json"
+	"fmt"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/chenhg5/cc-connect/core"
+)
+
+func TestHandleMsgCallback_TextStripsAtMentionAnywhere(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		name    string
+		content string
+		want    string
+	}{
+		{name: "prefix", content: "@xxbot allow", want: "allow"},
+		{name: "middle", content: "please @xxbot allow", want: "please allow"},
+		{name: "suffix", content: "allow @xxbot", want: "allow"},
+		{name: "unchanged", content: "allow", want: "allow"},
+	}
+
+	for i, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			p := &WSPlatform{allowFrom: "*"}
+			captured := make(chan *core.Message, 1)
+			p.handler = func(_ core.Platform, msg *core.Message) {
+				captured <- msg
+			}
+
+			body := wsMsgCallbackBody{
+				MsgID:    fmt.Sprintf("mention_%d", i),
+				ChatID:   "group_1",
+				ChatType: "group",
+				MsgType:  "text",
+			}
+			body.From.UserID = "user_1"
+			body.Text.Content = tt.content
+			body.CreateTime = time.Now().Unix()
+
+			bodyBytes, err := json.Marshal(body)
+			if err != nil {
+				t.Fatalf("marshal callback: %v", err)
+			}
+			p.handleMsgCallback(wsFrame{
+				Cmd:     "aibot_msg_callback",
+				Headers: wsFrameHeaders{ReqID: "req_mention"},
+				Body:    bodyBytes,
+			})
+
+			select {
+			case msg := <-captured:
+				if msg.Content != tt.want {
+					t.Fatalf("content = %q, want %q", msg.Content, tt.want)
+				}
+			case <-time.After(time.Second):
+				t.Fatal("handler not called")
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}
